subject: Customer credit memo offset + EU VAT tagging for March invoices
messages:
From: Marta Silva <marta@solventa.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@solventa.com, Jürgen Klein <jk@solventa.de>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Credit memo and VAT tag for March invoices

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for taking time this morning. We reviewed March invoices and found two credits we need applied before month-end close: a €18,450 service-level refund for overprovisioning (inv #R-3312) and a promotional credit of €2,000 that should offset the recurring plan (inv #R-3321).

Two requests to align on:
- Can Redwood post a customer credit memo against those invoices and confirm the AR movement? We need a clearing on our side to release payment for the remainder of the period.
- Important: For the service refund, our tax team insists the credit be tagged to the original invoices' EU VAT group (reverse-charge vs standard VAT) so our reclaim flow isn't broken.

I've attached a draft credit memo and exported the March invoice listing. Please loop in finance and tell us what JE you will post so we can mirror on our ledgers.

Appreciate a quick confirmation — our close begins Monday.

Best,
Marta
Head of Finance, Solventa GmbH

Attachments: CR_Solventa_creditmemo_0427.pdf; Solventa_Mar-Invoices_listing.csv

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Marta Silva <marta@solventa.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Credit memo and VAT tag for March invoices

Hi Marta — thanks for the details and attachments. We'll take this through finance ops. Initial plan below; Laura and Grace I've cc'd to pick up the JE posting and VAT tagging.

Planned actions:
1) Issue a customer credit memo (CRM) in Redwood billing for the two line items (€18,450 and €2,000). CRM will reference invoice #R-3312 and #R-3321.
2) Post an AR offset journal on 2027-04-02 to move the unapplied credit from 1200-AR to 1195-CustomerCredits pending allocation.
3) For VAT: tag the CRM lines with the original invoice tax codes. Marcus, can you confirm the correct tax code (RC vs STD) because Solventa is an EU B2B reverse-charge case?
4) Share the draft JE (xlsx) once posted; Marta please confirm that aligns with your accounting.

We'll aim to post the CRM and JE by EOD tomorrow.

— Priya
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Draft_JE_Solventa_0427.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Credit memo and VAT tag for March invoices

Priya / team — quick tax note. For these invoices the original sales were tagged as "RC-EU-B2B" (reverse charge). The credit memo should mirror that tagging to avoid forcing VAT onto the credit side and to let Solventa reclaim correctly.

Suggested JE lines (gross amounts in EUR):
- Dr Revenue Allowances (4xxxx) 20,450.00
- Cr Accounts Receivable 20,450.00
  -> Breakout: Cr VAT Liability (if any) 0.00 (reverse-charge) / ensure tax code RC-EU-B2B is applied in the CRM system meta field.

Note: If the CRM system cannot set a custom tax code field on the CRM, we will post a secondary tagging journal (FIN-TAX-ADJ) that maps the CRM to RC-EU-B2B for the audit trail. I'll coordinate with Laura on the posted entries.

Marcus
Senior Tax Analyst

P.S. I verified the invoice export — invoice R-3312 had an embedded PO and the customer VAT id matches the reverse charge rule.

From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 17:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Credit memo and VAT tag for March invoices — JE posted

Team / Marta,

Update — posted the CRM and JE today per Priya's plan. Summary below and included the posted JE xlsx in attachments.

Posted items (2027-04-02):
- Customer credit memo: CRM-2027-00478 referencing inv R-3312 and R-3321. Lines: €18,450 (service refund), €2,000 (promo). Tagged tax code: RC-EU-B2B (meta field).
- Journal entry (JE ID: JE-2027-8842):
  * Dr 4-4100 Revenue Allowances €20,450.00
  * Cr 1-1100 Accounts Receivable €20,450.00
  * No VAT liability entry required (reverse-charge preserved)
- Posted a mapping note to FIN-TAX-ADJ with cross-ref to CRM-2027-00478 and Solventa VAT ID.

Marta — please confirm you see CRM-2027-00478 on your remittance report and that our tagging is acceptable for your reclaim. If not, we can post a reversing adjustment and re-tag but that will delay close.

Laura Bennett
Senior Accounting Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: JE_Solventa_JE-2027-8842.xlsx

From: Marta Silva <marta@solventa.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Jürgen Klein <jk@solventa.de>, accounts-payable@solventa.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Credit memo and VAT tag for March invoices — confirmation from Solventa

Hi Laura / Priya —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We can confirm: CRM-2027-00478 landed on our remittance report and the amounts tie to our March aging. VAT tagging looks correct (RC-EU-B2B) and our tax team confirmed the credit memo will be treated as a reduction to the original taxable base rather than triggering a VAT liability.

Two final asks before we close this ticket (JIRA FIN-4521):
1) Could Redwood add a short audit note to JE-2027-8842 stating "reverse-charge mapping verified against customer VAT ID DE123456789" so our auditors have the cross-reference?
2) Please confirm the credit memo effective date is 2027-03-30 for reporting consistency.

If you agree, we'll mark the items cleared and dispatch the remaining payment on Thursday.

Best,
Marta
